details: The likelihood of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in December has increased to 68% following a stronger-than-expected US May jobs report, which added 172,000 jobs. This development is pressuring Bitcoin, which has fallen from around $82,000 to the low $60,000s as markets adjust to shifting rate expectations. Higher interest rates generally make riskier assets like cryptocurrencies less attractive.
title: US Fed Rate Hike Odds Rise on Strong Jobs Data, Pressuring Bitcoin

details: Renewed military conflict between Iran and Israel has triggered a sharp decline in Asian stocks and a spike in oil prices, leading to Bitcoin falling to around $62,900. This geopolitical instability, along with rising U.S. Treasury yields and outflows from Bitcoin ETFs, has contributed to a recent 14% loss for Bitcoin, challenging its role as a safe haven or "digital gold" during turmoil. Tech stocks have surged during this period, suggesting a shift away from crypto as investors sell assets to cover losses.
title: Geopolitical Tensions and Bitcoin's Retreat from "Digital Gold" Status

details: The European Central Bank (ECB) is widely expected to announce an interest rate hike on June 11, with markets pricing in a 99% probability of a 25 basis point increase to 2.25%. This comes as Eurozone CPI reached 3.2% in May, its highest in over two-and-a-half years, in a "stagflationary" environment where Q1 GDP has contracted. The ECB's forward guidance on future rate paths will be crucial for global liquidity and risk asset sentiment, including cryptocurrencies.
title: ECB Interest Rate Decision and Eurozone Inflation Outlook

details: The crypto market is closely watching the upcoming US Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, due on June 10. Consensus estimates suggest headline CPI will rise to 4.2% year-over-year from 3.8% previously. A higher-than-expected inflation reading could solidify the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy stance for longer, impacting crypto market liquidity and investor sentiment negatively. This data point is a major catalyst for potential volatility this week.
title: Anticipation Builds for US CPI Report Amidst Fed Policy Uncertainty

details: Spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) are experiencing sustained net outflows, contributing to downside pressure on digital assets. This trend suggests a potential shift from aggressive accumulation to institutional distribution, with liquidity possibly moving away from cryptocurrencies and towards the stock market or other risk-on assets.
title: Continued Bitcoin ETF Outflows Amidst Macro Pressures
